## Kuasai dasar dulu
Pelajari variabel, fungsi, array, dan objek. Buat program kecil seperti kalkulator atau daftar belanja di browser.
## Baru setelah itu framework
Setelah nyaman dengan dasar dan DOM, framework seperti React akan terasa jauh lebih masuk akal.

## Pakai pengelola kata sandi
Satu kata sandi kuat untuk pengelola, lalu biarkan aplikasi itu membuat kata sandi unik untuk setiap akun.
## Nyalakan verifikasi dua langkah
Aktifkan di email dan media sosial. Kode tambahan membuat kata sandi yang bocor tidak cukup untuk masuk.

articles.title: Cara merawat laptop supaya tetap awet

body: Laptop yang lambat sering kali bukan karena rusak, tetapi karena jarang dirawat.

Jangan menaruh laptop di kasur. Bersihkan debu di ventilasi setiap beberapa bulan.
## Rapikan aplikasi yang berjalan otomatis
Matikan aplikasi yang tidak perlu berjalan saat laptop menyala.

body: Git membantu menyimpan riwayat perubahan kode, seperti tombol undo yang bisa diputar ke masa lalu.
## Commit adalah titik simpan
Setiap commit menyimpan keadaan kode saat itu beserta catatan singkat.
## Branch untuk mencoba hal baru
Buat branch sebelum mencoba fitur baru, supaya kode utama tetap aman.

HP yang rutin mendapat pembaruan keamanan akan lebih aman dipakai bertahun-tahun.

articles.title: Learning JavaScript from scratch: where to start?
articles.excerpt: A sensible learning order for beginners, without jumping straight into frameworks.
body: Many people give up on JavaScript because they jump straight into a framework. The basics can be learned in a few weeks.
## Master the basics first
Learn variables, functions, arrays, and objects. Build small programs like a calculator or a shopping list in the browser.
## Frameworks come after
Once you're comfortable with the basics and the DOM, frameworks like React will make much more sense.

articles.title: Five simple habits to keep your online accounts safe
articles.excerpt: Small steps that prevent most account takeovers.
body: Most accounts get broken into not by genius hackers, but because of reused passwords.
## Use a password manager
One strong password for the manager, then let it create a unique password for every account.
## Turn on two-step verification
Enable it on your email and social media. The extra code means a leaked password isn't enough to get in.

articles.title: How to care for your laptop so it lasts
articles.excerpt: Daily habits that keep your laptop fast and cool.
body: A slow laptop often isn't broken, just neglected.
## Keep the air flowing
Don't use your laptop on the bed. Clean the dust from the vents every few months.
## Trim startup apps
Turn off apps that don't need to run when the laptop starts.

articles.title: Git for beginners: saving your code's history
articles.excerpt: Commits, branches, and pushes explained with simple examples.
body: Git saves the history of your code changes, like an undo button that can rewind time.
## A commit is a save point
Each commit saves the state of your code along with a short note.
## Branches for trying new things
Create a branch before trying a new feature, so your main code stays safe.

articles.title: Choosing a phone for work and school
articles.excerpt: The specs that really matter, and the ones you can ignore.
body: A big camera number doesn't always mean a phone that's right for work.
## Prioritize RAM and battery
For running many apps at once, RAM and battery life make the biggest difference.
## Check the update support window
A phone that gets regular security updates stays safer for years.
